title: The Funeral Livestream
narration: During my sister's funeral livestream, the woman inside the coffin opened her eyes. Lucy messaged me to stop watching, so I drove to her house and found her tied to a chair. Once freed, she whispered that I should never have returned. Her husband showed me the stream's timestamp: tomorrow. The camera moved close enough to reveal that the body in the coffin was mine. The silence felt deliberate, as though someone nearby was waiting for me to understand the trap before moving again. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. Every explanation I tried made the details worse, because each clue had been placed where I alone would find it. Lucy locked the front door and calmly said, 'Now we can film the beginning.'
